newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA C.BANK RESERVES CLIMBS TO $1.49 BLN IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA C.BANK RESERVES CLIMBS TO $1.49 BLN IN MAY.

text.p: Central bank (BNR) total foreign exchange reserves rose to $1.495 billion at end-May from $1.45 billion in April as the BNR continued to soak up excess dollars from Romania's market, data showed on Wednesday.
Over the past months the BNR drained large hard currency inflows after growing interest in Romanian equities and securities. Its moves sought to prevent a firming of the leu, harmful for exporters.
Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu last month said BNR reserves were expected to grow further, putting their year-end estimate at some $3 billion.
The leu traded relatively stable near 7,100 to the dollar last month after a strong recovery from a record low of 9,000 in mid-February.
BNR data also showed foreign reserve assets in the banking system rose to $3.17 billion in April from $2.88 billion in March. Figures on May reserve assets were not available.
End-April reserve assets included gold reserves of about 90 tonnes, Special Drawing Rights and hard currency reserves of local banks and of the BNR.
